title: Kth Smallest Element In A Sorted Matrix
description:
Given an `n x n` matrix whose rows and columns are sorted in non-decreasing order, return the `k`th smallest matrix element. Duplicate values occupy separate ranks.

## Examples

```text
Input: matrix = [[1, 5, 9], [10, 11, 13], [12, 13, 15]], k = 8
Output: 13
```

```text
Input: matrix = [[-5]], k = 1
Output: -5
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 300`
- `-10^9 <= matrix[i][j] <= 10^9`
- Rows and columns are sorted in non-decreasing order.
- `1 <= k <= n^2`
